summary: Gabriel Wright, 47, of Telluride, a professional-level backcountry snowboarder, was found unresponsive and pulseless in Bear Creek backcountry below Nellie Mine on 2018-02-25; third of three descending ~2pm, he had an unwitnessed fatal event; friends performed CPR for at least 30 minutes without revival. Evidence suggested he clipped a rock at speed and struck a small log under the snow. SAR extricated the body by helicopter (assisted by Olathe Spray Helicopter); no avalanche was involved.
location: Bear Creek backcountry, below Nellie Mine, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR, Olathe Spray Helicopter
